offering_description.value: Buys flat-rolled steel coil from mills and processes it into value-added products such as pickled, cold-rolled, galvanized and cut-to-length steel, plus electrical steel laminations and tailor welded blanks. Sells mainly to automotive, construction, heavy truck, agriculture and appliance customers under contract, spot and tolling arrangements.

primary_products.value: processed flat-rolled steel (coil and sheet); electrical steel laminations and cores; tailor welded blanks; galvanized and painted steel

primary_services.value: steel toll processing; slitting and cutting to length; pickling; steel coating and galvanizing

customer_segment.value: B2B: automotive OEMs and suppliers, construction, heavy truck, agriculture, appliance and energy manufacturers, steel service centers

end_markets.value: automotive; construction; heavy truck and equipment; agriculture; energy and electrical

revenue_model.value: product sales: processed steel sold on spot and contract pricing; service fees: toll processing fees for steel owned by customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: buys coil from steel mills, processes it, and sells to manufacturers and service centers; service provider: processes customer-owned steel on a tolling basis

geography_served.value: North America: US, Canada and Mexico facilities, with operations and some sales in Europe and elsewhere

specialization.value: related lines: steel processing, electrical steel laminations, tailor welded blanks and related processing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales force selling to OEMs, manufacturers and service centers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, workplace safety and emissions rules for steel processing, trade tariffs affect steel

notes: Based on recollection after the 2023 spin-off from Worthington Enterprises; exact segment mix and Europe footprint are uncertain.
